title: Zesty Glazed Polish Cheese Lasagna
description: A sour and cheesy one-pot Polish dish featuring ground nutmeg and a sweet glaze, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package directions and set aside
In a large copper pot, combine the ricotta cheese, shredded mozzarella, ground nutmeg, sour cream, salt, and pepper, and mix well
Add the cooked lasagna noodles to the cheese mixture and stir until they are well coated
In a small bowl, whisk together the glaze ingredients, which include 1/2 cup sour cream, 1/4 cup shredded mozzarella, and 1 tsp dried parsley
Pour the glaze over the top of the lasagna mixture in the copper pot
Dot the top of the glaze with the butter
Cover the copper pot with a lid and bake for 25 minutes
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned
